X.-Z. CHEN

Research Assistant Professor, IDT & EIT, Ningbo

Research interests: Majorana, Altermagnet, Quantum Transport, Mesoscopic Physics

Work email: xzchen@idt.eitech.edu.cn | Gmail: chenxzhlzu@gmail.com

Research & background

I study quantum transport and topological quantum devices, with a focus on Majorana modes, magnetic textures, and altermagnets. My research combines analytical modeling with numerical simulations to connect microscopic electronic structure, topology, and experimentally accessible transport signals. My earlier work examined scanning gate microscopy, quantum scars, and many-body spectral statistics in graphene nanostructures.

Ningbo Institute of Digital Twin & Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo. I work with Prof. Tong Zhou’s group in Ningbo, China.

Methods & interests

I use Kwant for quantum transport and Bogoliubov–de Gennes models, micromagnetic simulations for magnetic textures, and first-principles calculations for electronic structure.

  • Altermagnets and topological transport
  • Majorana modes and quantum devices
  • Graphene and mesoscopic physics
